objective.primary: minimize expected total seasonal irrigation while satisfying the requested yield-protection constraint
objective.total_irrigation_definition: 45 mm fixed preplant irrigation + executed postplant policy irrigation
objective.optimization_equivalence_note: The fixed 45-mm preplant event is common to every policy, so minimizing total seasonal irrigation is equivalent to minimizing controllable postplant irrigation.

yield_retention.reason_not_clipped: A policy is allowed to exceed the frozen full-water reference yield in a weather year; clipping would discard real improvement.

reference.definition: Yield of the frozen quota-normalized Huaxing conventional W100 schedule under the same weather year and identical non-water management.

risk_measure.name: empirical_lower_CVaR
risk_measure.alpha_semantics: lower-tail probability mass; alpha=0.20 means the worst 20 percent of equally weighted weather-year mass, not an 80 or 95 percent confidence level
risk_measure.finite_sample_estimator: Sort n retentions ascending. Let m=alpha*n, k=floor(m), f=m-k. Average the worst k observations plus fractional weight f on the next observation, divided by m.
risk_measure.statistical_claim: The formal constraint is defined on the empirical equally weighted weather-year distribution; no population confidence interval is implied by the contract.

protection_targets.primary_reporting: report every registered eta level separately; do not select a favorable eta after training

split_governance.training: Risk optimization and gradient updates may use only 2000-2017 ERA5 years.
split_governance.validation: 2018-2022 ERA5 years may be used for checkpoint/hyperparameter selection under a preregistered learned-method selection rule, but never for gradient updates.
split_governance.final_test: 2023-2025 Huaxing station outcomes and station-derived Y_ref values remain inaccessible until the learned methods, checkpoints, hyperparameters and risk settings are frozen.
split_governance.reference_rule: Development Y_ref values may be precomputed for 2000-2022. Station Y_ref values are generated only during final evaluation after the development lock.

feasibility.note: Numerical floating-point tolerances in code are not scientific feasibility slack.

change_rule: Any change to Y_ref, alpha, eta levels, weather weighting or finite-sample LCVaR semantics after learned-policy training begins requires a new risk-contract version and cannot overwrite v1.
